pitch_detail.notes: About 1.5 mi up the East Eagle Trail along the valley floor.
Steep, loose rib between two drainages on the west side. Exposure and big loose blocks; the crux of the day.
Cross the crest between the two tops of the double summit; the east summit is the higher.
Follow the ridge, then drop rubbly, loose slopes toward Crater Lake.
pitch_detail.pitch: Crest and descent to Crater Lake

pitch_detail.notes: Little Kettle Creek Trail down many switchbacks to the East Eagle Trailhead.
Arapaho Pass trail to the mine ruins, Arapaho Glacier trail to the saddle, then a loose rocky scramble past a false summit to the top.
Leave South Arapaho northward; an exposed downclimb of about 50 ft, then sustained blocky scrambling. Stay near the crest, escape west at difficulties.
About three quarters of the way along: two short steps of roughly 8-10 ft each on good holds, above exposure.
Easier ground, sometimes a snow patch, to the broad summit.
Reverse the ridge back to South Arapaho; the crux steps are downclimbed.
Scramble off South Arapaho and follow the trails back down.
